START_NO_END.desc: Start Time filled but End Time is blank

RAN_NO_QTY.desc: Production run happened + has a Planned qty, but Actual (completed) Quantity is blank

END_NO_START.desc: End Time filled but Start Time is blank

QTY_NO_OPS.desc: Actual qty present but Number of Operators blank/0 (labor $/unit uncomputable)

QTY_NO_TIME.desc: Actual qty present but Actual Time blank/0 (labor $/unit uncomputable)

REF_ERROR.desc: A mapped cell holds a spreadsheet error (#REF!, #N/A, ...)

MISSING_COLUMN.desc: A load-bearing column is absent from the sheet — the stage cannot be costed

DERIVED_COLUMN.desc: A computed time column was removed; costlib is re-deriving it from surviving inputs
